verdict.rationale: Unity documents a first-party Package Manager that delivers 'a wide range of enhancements', backed by a live UPM registry serving packages. Community evidence shows a Unity Store that distributed third-party plugins such as VLC-Unity, though the VideoLAN account also shows Unity removing a plugin publisher. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the Asset Store itself, evidence of its scale ('large'), evidence of ready-made models/art assets, and independent corroboration of ecosystem breadth.

support.subject: As a game developer, a large asset store or package ecosystem gives me ready-made models, tools, and plugins

citations.quote: Packages deliver a wide range of enhancements to Unity through the Package Manager.
